title: E4M3/E5M2 profile stability: fuzz-testing simulator and sensitivity matrix for FP8 enablement
creator: Asha Menon
description: Goal: Produce a reproducible fuzz-testing simulator and sensitivity matrix to validate FP8 (E4M3/E5M2) quantization profiles across representative Hopper model families and enable safe, automated activation heuristics. This ticket covers: (1) a stochastic perturbation harness that applies per-layer scale jitter, activation noise, and KV-cache prefix perturbations; (2) an automated calibration sweep runner that computes layerwise scale factors and per-op overflow risk; (3) a sensitivity matrix analysis that ranks layers and ops by degradation risk for profile selection; and (4) a decision surface that gates profile activation or fallback to INT8/FP16 based on telemetry thresholds. Expected outcome: a calibration artifact that feeds into the rollout canary and the runtime's profile selection service.
acceptance_criteria: Fuzz simulator can run end-to-end on a 1k-sample golden prompt set and produce reproducible metrics (token-level edit distance, perplexity delta, embedding cosine) within 5% variance over 5 independent runs.
Sensitivity matrix is computed for at least 3 Hopper models (decoder-only and encoder-decoder variants) and identifies top-10 high-risk layers for each model.
Automated calibration runner outputs per-layer safe scale ranges and a recommended profile JSON that the runtime can ingest.
Telemetry gates defined (latency, error-rate, quality-delta) and a fallback policy implemented: <metric thresholds> -> fallback to INT8 or FP16 seamlessly.
Integration tests added: simulated drift triggers fallback in runtime CI and a canary traffic run with shadow activation completes without customer-visible errors.
steps: Design fuzz patterns: per-layer scale jitter, attention temperature sweep, kv-prefix truncation, and token dropout to simulate tokenization edge-cases
Implement harness in calibration-sim service (calib-sim) with config-driven perturbation generators
Add metric collectors: token-level ED, perplexity delta, embedding cosine similarity vs golden outputs, and inference-side overflow counters
Create sensitivity matrix generator that correlates perturbation magnitude with quality degradation per-layer and per-op
Run bulk sweeps across three Hopper model checkpoints; store artifacts in GCS and catalog runs in BigQuery
Implement activation gate translator that maps sensitivity scores to runtime heuristics (activation_hysteresis, safe_scale_range, fallback_target)
Ship initial PR to runtime for ingestion of recommended profile JSON and fallback rules; add canary pipeline
Validate with shadow canary on dedicated cluster and produce a rollout playbook

observability_notes: Added span tags: calib_sim.run_id, perturbation_profile, top_risky_layers. Telemetry events: calib.sensitivity_scan.completed, calib.activation_recommendation.emitted. Dashboards: sensitivity-heatmap and canary-fallbacks.
qa_plan: Synthetic canary: run 2k golden prompts with shadow FP8 activation; assert no regression > 1.5% embedding cosine drop. CI: unit tests for perturbation generators and end-to-end smoke that simulates overflow->fallback path.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: nondeterministic simulator variance hides regressions. Mitigation: deterministic RNG seeds for CI, run ensemble of seeds in production calibration, require consensus across seeds before emitting activation recommendation. Risk: runtime ingestion bug. Mitigation: strict schema validation and dry-run mode in runtime ingestion PR.
